description: Support-tier definitions for settlement adapters. A manifest claiming a tier MUST have status `pass` for every class the tier requires (validated by scripts/validate-certification.py; normative text in docs/certification/adapter_certification.md).

production.additional: All `supported` classes PLUS (a) an `independent_audit` of the settlement-facing contracts and circuits, and (b) an operator-signed live-deployment acceptance record against the production deployment with runbook on-call coverage. A live mainnet deployment that is unaudited is a DEV/PILOT instance, not production — it may claim at most `supported`. No adapter currently claims `production`.
